# OpenSocrates 1.1.0

OpenSocrates 1.1.0 adds Claude support while preserving the existing Codex
workflow and the published `opensocrates` npm installer.

## Highlights

- Automatic reasoning-system selection for Claude Code CLI, Claude Code
  desktop, and supported local Cowork tasks.
- Generated reasoning skills usable across Claude plugin surfaces; Claude web
  and Desktop Chat remain skills-only because they do not execute hooks.
- `npx --yes opensocrates@1.1.0 install --host claude` for Claude and the
  existing default installation path for Codex.
- Separate verified Claude and Codex release assets with package-level
  checksums and a shared native runtime.
- A separate runtime-free `claude-chat-skills.zip` for custom upload in Claude
  web and Desktop Chat.
- A fail-open, 30-second Claude safe-mode selector with no tools, MCP servers,
  project instructions, session persistence, or API-key requirement.

The packaged runtime remains validated only for Apple-silicon macOS. Binary
signing, notarization, clean-machine installation, and live delivery on every
Claude surface remain outside the measured release claim.
